timing_scope: Corrected-source CTS placement-estimated SS/FF under unchanged declared vehicle IO contract; no global route/SPEF/signoff/power

source_semantics.tree_fault: Sticky until reset: queue overflow or non-final root at maximum tree depth; not the arithmetic oerr/perr flag.
source_semantics.element_fault: ffault OR every bank compute/tree fault
source_semantics.publication: fault[g] = (e_fault[g] & iso_q) | late | ctl_fault; isolation applies only to element fault, AO late/control errors stay visible.
source_semantics.result: pv and payload are independently published; top-level RTL does not suppress pv or busy on fault.
source_semantics.exact_contract: Existing bench compares pv, busy and fault together every cycle, and payload on valid; no delayed-fault contract.
source_semantics.production_parent: No instantiation found in rtl other than test/signoff benches; synchronous quarantine sampler/acceptance contract is absent.

fault_only_register.verdict: NOT_ADMISSIBLE: adds a fault-blind acceptance cycle; cannot claim synchronous quarantine preservation

paired_output_register.includes: Both bank pv/payload/error plus busy and fault
paired_output_register.publication_quarantine: Requires actual parent acceptance barrier, fault-stop policy and retained ownership; retiming alone is not a quarantine implementation.
paired_output_register.verdict: NOT_ADMITTED: parent behavior, local capture timing and physical FF/mux cost not bound

combinational_repair.verdict: No source-sized implementation prescribed; do not assume 202.47ps free recovery or preserve hold by assertion

required_parent_fields: actual parent instance/source SHA and fault consumer endpoint
fault capture reference clock and SS latest / FF earliest arrival budget
same-edge pv acceptance vs fault quarantine priority
whether outstanding publications are poisoned/discarded on sticky tree fault
maximum permitted fault-stop latency and drain/reset/isolation ownership
